newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.20 percentage points to 1.10 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 99.00818 pesos.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 2.466 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 728-day Bondes, fell 0.16 percentage points to 1.15 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 98.11736 pesos.
Demand for the 728-day Bondes was 3.550 billion pesos, compared with the 700 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
